name: imovies-movie-ticket-booking-system
description: IMovies - a MERN stack movie ticket booking system (React, Express, MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix e2e install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --omit=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start:demo: npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/start-demo.mjs
